feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 30 October 2026 11:29am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Friday, 30 October 2026 at 11:30am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds in the west at first.


##Synopsis##

High pressure to the east of the British Isles and deep area of low pressure near Greenland.


##Wind##

South or southeast 4 or 5, occasionally 6 in the west at first, decreasing mainly 3 or 4 through this evening.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, although remaining slight in the southeast. Falling slight in all waters overnight.


##Weather##

Mainly fair, risk of mist or fog patches in the east Saturday morning.


##Visibility##

Mainly good, risk of poor or very poor in any mist or fog patches later.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

South or southeast 3 or 4, gradually veering south or southwest Saturday afternoon. Then becoming north 4 or 5 overnight into Sunday.


##State of Sea##

Slight, occasionally moderate in west later.


##Weather##

Mainly fair, although risk of mist or fog patches in the east Saturday night and Sunday morning.


##Visibility##

Mainly good, risk of poor or very poor in the east.
